NAME: Arianne A. Villaluna
INTRO: I’m an engineer who connects customers, technical teams and business processes. Seven years at Huawei and 3M taught me where handovers get lost, and how to fix them. Now I’m in Oslo, ready for the next team. Hook: "I think in systems."
KEY NUMBERS: 7+ years in operations at Huawei and 3M; $15M largest pre-sales-to-delivery project handled; 100% data integrity across 10,000+ product attributes
QUICK FACTS: Based in: Oslo, Norway; From: The Philippines; By training: Electronics engineer; At heart: An event person; Currently learning: Norwegian (B1 → B2); On Sundays: Søndagstur, always
WAYS TO WORK WITH HER (consulting, part-time or full-time):
- Sales-to-delivery process design: From the first quote to the delivered order, without things falling through the cracks. Includes: Quote-to-order and order-to-delivery workflows, BOQ/BOM configuration, Handover within SLA, CRM/CPQ hygiene. Proof: Huawei: projects up to USD 15M.
- Product data & digital operations: A catalogue your customers and sales team can trust, in every market and channel. Includes: PIM/DAM setup and governance, Catalogue quality, B2B and B2C publishing. Proof: 3M: 100% data integrity across 10,000+ attributes.
- Process improvement & onboarding: Shorter ramp-up for new people, and workflows that don’t live in one person’s head. Includes: Onboarding design, Documentation people actually use, Team workflows. Proof: 3M: a 1-hour onboarding meeting turned into a 15-minute guided video, plus a new-hire framework.
- Early-stage product & venture support: Structure for founders who are moving from idea to first customers. Includes: User research, Prototyping, Go-to-market structure. Proof: Track record: goIT / TCS × Inno-Sci programme, Merita, UiO MSc.
- Events & community: Planning and running professional events and community programmes. Includes: Professional events, Community programmes. Proof: Huawei & 3M: six years leading engagement teams.
HOW AN ENGAGEMENT WORKS: Conversation: A 30-minute call to understand where things get stuck and whether I’m the right fit. Map: I walk through the process with the people who run it and pinpoint the handovers that break. Fix: We design and put in place the changes together: workflows, data rules, templates, tooling. Hand over: Documentation and training so the improvement keeps working after I step back.
WHO SHE WORKS WITH: SMBs and scale-ups whose processes haven’t kept up with growth; Startups that need operational structure before they scale; Teams in the startup and incubator ecosystem around Oslo
CASE STUDIES:
- From design to delivery at scale (Huawei · Telecom; Product Configuration Engineer · Mar 2015 – Aug 2020). Problem: Nationwide network rollouts and modernisation projects start as high-level designs. Before anything ships, every site needs an exact configuration and bill of quantities, and every change has to flow through to contracts, orders and delivery. Errors at that stage turn into cost and delay in the field. Approach: Translated high-level designs into configurations and BOQs for 1 to 300+ sites per project; Kept configurations and contracts aligned through around 80 contract amendments a year; Coordinated order-to-delivery for two years (CCM-CC) so handovers met SLA; Led a team of three and ran internal trainings. Outcome: Projects valued at USD 300K–8M configured and delivered, with pre-sales-to-delivery ownership up to USD 15M, and contributions to four winning multi-year bids.
- One catalogue, many markets (3M · Product data; Digitization Senior Analyst · Aug 2020 – Aug 2022). Problem: A global product catalogue has to read correctly in every market, for business and consumer buyers alike. With thousands of attributes per project, small inconsistencies multiply fast and end up in front of customers. Approach: Led the AU/NZ catalogue on 3M.com; Managed product data in GPIM (SAP Hybris) and assets in DAM (Celum, Adobe); Handled 200+ JIRA requests a year from teams across the business; Applied consistent localisation and governance before publishing. Outcome: 100% data integrity across 10,000+ attributes and 400+ SKUs per project, published to both B2B and B2C channels.
- Onboarding in 15 minutes (3M · Process improvement; Digitization Senior Analyst · 3M). Problem: Getting new team members up to speed relied on a one-hour live meeting. It took experienced people away from their work, and the result depended on who ran it. Approach: Replaced the live meeting with a 15-minute guided video; Built a new-hire framework so every starter follows the same path; Documented the underlying workflows; Wrote a research paper on digital onboarding. Outcome: Onboarding time cut from one hour to 15 minutes. It was one of two process improvements I introduced at 3M that are still in use.
CAREER STORY:
- Philippines: Electronics & Communications Engineering, Bachelor of Science. Recognised as equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree by HK-dir; Organisation of the Year and Journalist of the Year awards; Later returned as Guest Instructor: Fundamentals of Transport Solutions (2020)
- Mar 2015 – Aug 2020: Huawei, Product Configuration Engineer. Configurations and BOQs for 1–300+ sites, valued USD 300K–8M; Pre-sales-to-delivery up to USD 15M; ~150 configurations and ~80 contract amendments a year; Contributed to 4 winning multi-year bids; 2 years of order-to-delivery coordination (CCM-CC); Led a team of 3 and ran internal trainings
- Aug 2020 – Aug 2022: 3M, Digitization Senior Analyst. AU/NZ catalogue lead on 3M.com; GPIM (SAP Hybris) and DAM (Celum, Adobe); 200+ JIRA requests a year; 100% data integrity, 10,000+ attributes, 400+ SKUs per project; 2 process improvements still in use; GSC PH Digital Hackathon 2021: People’s Choice Award
- 2022: Norway, A new chapter in Oslo. Relocated from the Philippines; Master’s-level elective at OsloMet (grade A); Learning Norwegian, now at B1 and working toward B2
- 2026 – 2028: University of Oslo, MSc Entrepreneurship & Innovation Management. Department of Informatics; Focus on venture creation
CREDENTIALS & LANGUAGES: Salesforce Certified AI Associate; 3M Certified Scrum Team Member; Asana Workflow Specialist; CCNA Bootcamp; English C1; Norwegian B1 (working toward B2)
IN THREE WORDS: Systems-minded, Warm, Reliable
BEYOND WORK:
- Events: I’ve been the person who makes the event happen for most of my career. Chief Engagement Officer, Huawei (2016–2020); Engagement Team Lead, 3M (2020–2022); Volunteer: PMI Norway 25th Anniversary conference support, FEIT, Kalayaan Norge
- Social media: Telling a community’s story, in posts, photos and video. Social Media Manager, Kalayaan Norge; Photo and video coverage with Abyss Creatives
- Entrepreneurship: Merita is a product for immigrant job seekers in Norway, developed in the Insj UiO incubator. It grew out of Klar4Jobb, an earlier prototype of a job-readiness companion. 
- The Norway journey: I moved from the Philippines to Norway in 2022. I’m learning Norwegian (B1, working toward B2), and Sunday means one thing: søndagstur. 
- Layout & visual design: Wedding layouts and presentation design. A small selection, because good structure is a design skill too.
OFF THE CLOCK:
- The event person: Six years leading engagement teams at Huawei and 3M, and still volunteering at events around Oslo.
- The layout designer: Wedding layouts and presentation design. I can’t leave a misaligned margin alone.
- The storyteller: Social media for Kalayaan Norge, plus photo and video coverage with Abyss Creatives.
- The builder: Working on Merita, a product for immigrant job seekers, in the Insj UiO incubator.
- The newcomer: From the Philippines to Oslo in 2022. Norwegian at B1 and climbing.
- The Sunday walker: Søndagstur, every week, whatever the weather.
CONTACT: Book a 30-minute conversation on the Contact page (/en/contact/ or /no/contact/). Ask anything via the form on the Secret identity page (/en/secret-identity/).   Based in Oslo, Norway.
